title: Reconnect the System
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can understand the 4 sentence types in English and practice Yes-No questions with DO/ARE to distinguish action verbs from 'to be'.
today: Practice Do you...? vs Are you...?
Answer with Yes, I do / Yes, I am

examples.text: I have a meeting with my colleague.

items.def: someone you know, but not well

examples.text: He's just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
I met an acquaintance at the conference.

items.def: you can depend on this person

examples.text: She's very reliable — always on time.
My brother is reliable. I can count on him.
He's very considerate — he always asks how I feel.
Please be considerate of other people's time.
My manager is easy-going. She never shouts.
He's easy-going — nothing stresses him out.
I get along with my coworkers.
She gets along with everyone in the family.
I lost touch with my old classmates.
We lost touch after he changed jobs.

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

Example
Use

Engine
Question
Answer
rows: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

reading.text: Honestly, I can't stand unnecessary meetings. They waste a lot of time mainly because nothing gets decided. For example, some meetings could be replaced with a short email. However, I don't mind meetings that have a clear purpose. In my experience, a short agenda makes a meeting worth the time.
Notice: can't stand + noun, don't mind + V-ing, worth + noun. These are natural ways to express opinions.

conversations.title: New friend · at a café

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, is this seat free?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it is. Please have a seat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks. Do you come here often?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I do. I usually come here after work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you work near here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I do. My office is across the street.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you on your lunch break?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I'm not. I've finished work for today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lucky you! Are you free this evening?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I am. I'm meeting some friends later.

check: Does B work near the café?
Is B on a lunch break?
conversations.answers: 1. Yes, the office is across the street. 2. No, B has finished work. 3. Yes, meeting friends later.
conversations.note: Notice: work near here → lunch break → free this evening. Each question follows a detail in the last answer.

conversations.title: Morning together

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning. Are you still tired?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little. I didn't sleep very well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you want some coffee?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, please. That would be great.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I am. I'd love some breakfast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you want to eat at home?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I don't. Let's go out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Are you busy this morning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm free until noon.

conversations.answers: 1. No. 2. Yes. 3. No, free until noon.
conversations.note: Notice: tired → coffee → hungry → eat at home → busy this morning.

conversations.title: Work update with the boss
conversations.target: Do you have a minute? · Are you free now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, do you have a minute?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. What's up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like to update you. Are you free now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I am. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you need the final report today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I do. I need it before four.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you happy with the current format?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly, but the summary needs to be shorter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you want me to add the latest sales figures?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, please. That would be helpful.

check: Does the boss need the report today?
conversations.answers: 1. Yes, before four. 2. Yes. 3. The latest sales figures.
conversations.note: Notice: time → deadline → format → next action.

listening.text: Shadowing · Nghe từng câu rồi nhắc lại
Bấm 🔊 để nghe từng câu, sau đó nhắc lại y hệt ngữ điệu. Làm 2 lượt: lượt 1 nhìn chữ, lượt 2 che chữ.

exercises.text: Đáp án: 1 reliable · 2 easy-going · 3 considerate · 4 acquaintance. Which clue helped you choose each word? Gạch chân từ gợi ý trước khi chọn.
Đáp án: 1 Do · 2 Are · 3 Does · 4 Is · 5 Do · 6 Are. Quy tắc: action verb → DO/DOES, BE information → ARE/IS.

speaking.text: Question lab · What can't you stand?
Is there anything you can't stand at work or in daily life?

items: I can't stand waiting in traffic.

speaking.text: Use: I can't stand + noun / V-ing. Ask a partner: What about you?

roleplay.title: Mission 1 · New friend at a café
roleplay.context: Bạn đang ngồi một mình. Một người trông thân thiện ngồi gần đó. Mở cuộc trò chuyện nhẹ.
steps: Hình dung: bạn đang ở đâu, người kia tâm trạng thế nào, bạn muốn biết gì.
Opener: Hi, is this seat free?
Hỏi ít nhất 3 Yes–No: một câu Do you…? và một câu Are you…?
Nghe 1 chi tiết trong câu trả lời rồi hỏi follow-up thật.
Đường ý (không phải câu mẫu): the café · work/study · drinks · free time
roleplay.useful: Do you come here often? · Do you work near here? · Are you on your lunch break? · Are you free this evening?

roleplay.title: Mission 2 · Morning together
roleplay.context: Buổi sáng với người yêu nước ngoài. Gần gũi, bình thường, không cần nói chuyện lớn.
steps: Hình dung khoảnh khắc vừa thức dậy.
Opener: Good morning. Are you still tired?
Hỏi 3+ Yes–No (Do you…? và Are you…?).
Bám chi tiết vừa nghe, đừng đọc list.
Đường ý: sleep · breakfast · today's plan · mood
roleplay.useful: Do you want some coffee? · Are you hungry? · Do you want to eat at home? · Are you busy this morning?

roleplay.title: Mission 3 · Work update
roleplay.context: Cập nhật tiến độ với sếp. Kiểm tra thời gian và yêu cầu trước khi trình bày.
steps: Hình dung sếp đang bận hay rảnh.
Opener: Hi, do you have a minute?
Đường ý: the report · deadline · meeting · next step
roleplay.useful: Are you free now? · Do you need the final report today? · Are you happy with the current format? · Do you want me to add…?

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation about people you know. Use DO/ARE questions and answer with full sentences.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ full answers. Notice when you use DO vs ARE.

reference.text: Che cột tiếng Anh, dịch từ tiếng Việt. Sau đó đảo chiều. Chạy lượt 2 theo thứ tự ngẫu nhiên.
